faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Common questions about cash runway, burn rates, and financial planning.
faqs.q1: What is the formula to calculate runway in months?
faqs.a1: Runway (Months) = Available Cash Balance ÷ Net Monthly Burn Rate. If you have $150,000 in cash and a net monthly burn of $15,000, your runway is 10 months.
faqs.q2: What is the difference between gross burn and net burn?
faqs.a2: Gross burn is the total cash your business spends each month (e.g. $40,000). Net burn is gross burn minus incoming cash collections (e.g. $40,000 expenses - $15,000 revenue = $25,000 net burn).
faqs.q3: How much runway should a seed-stage startup maintain?
faqs.a3: Seed startups should aim for 18 to 24 months of cash runway. This provides 12 to 15 months to achieve product-market fit milestones, plus a mandatory 6-month window to negotiate and close the next financing round.
faqs.q4: Is my proprietary financial data stored on your servers?
faqs.a4: No. All calculation models run 100% client-side inside your browser's local JavaScript runtime. No salary numbers, bank figures, or revenue metrics are ever sent to our servers or stored in any database.
